label: Dumbledore
description: Serene, twinkling, and offering you a lemon drop at every junction.
direction: Speak softly and slowly, in a gentle, elderly English voice: calm, kindly and amused, as if sharing a small secret. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The gentle, whimsical headmaster: sweets, socks and quiet wisdom, with his sayings echoed in a few words rather than quoted. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
rights.author: J.K. Rowling; the film adaptations this register comes from are Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None. J.K. Rowling is living and the books are in copyright; Warner Bros. holds the film rights and the trademarks. Richard Harris, who first played the role on film, died in 2002, and Michael Gambon, who succeeded him, died in 2023; a performer's death does not put a performance in the public domain.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Time for one lemon drop.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Patience is its own magic.
lines.start_drive_1: Ah, good day. A few words before we go: nitwit, oddment, tweak. Thank you.
lines.start_drive_2: Welcome, welcome. Shall we be off?
lines.start_drive_3: Lemon drop? No? Then let us depart.
lines.start_drive_4: It is our choices that matter. I suggest we choose this route.
lines.start_drive_5: Help will always be given to drivers who ask for it.
lines.start_drive_6: I do enjoy a little outing. Off we pop. Pip pip.
lines.start_drive_7: One can never have enough socks, or enough time. Let us go.
lines.start_drive_8: Come. Let us pursue that flighty temptress, adventure.
lines.start_drive_9: Curious. Most curious. No matter. Onward.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Alas, even I take a wrong turning now and then.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Ten points to the driver. Well done.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Pip pip.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. As twisty as the Hogwarts staircases.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Alas. It does not do to dwell on delays.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Go gently, please.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I must ask you to be very careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I would slow down, if I were you.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Even in dark times, one must stop at the light.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. The Ministry is watching. Best behaviour, please.
lines.reroute_chime: Alas, we missed it. Fear not. There is another way.
